length_in.note: 2026 Subaru Solterra Specifications. Saved as sources/subaru-2026-solterra-specifications.pdf. The 2027 press kit has no spec sheet and says it 'continues with the same lineup as the 2026 model'.

width_in.note: 'Width'; the sheet doesn't say whether mirrors are included. C/D lists the same figure as width without mirrors.

awd.note: 2026 press kit: 'Every 2026 Solterra is equipped with standard Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive'. 2027 press kit: 'Standard Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive'.

charge_port.note: 2026 press kit: 'All 2026 Solterra models feature a North American Charging Standard charging port'. 2026 spec sheet: 'NACS charge inlet on right fender'. 2027 press kit: 'All 2027 Solterra models feature a North American Charging Standard (NACS) charging port'.

us_status.note: 2027 press kit: 'The 2027 Subaru Solterra EV arrives at retailers nationwide this fall.' 2026 press kit said the 2026 would be 'Available at retailers nationwide later this fall' (2025).
